globalTips: With the USD/JPY rate at ~162.7, your dollar stretches far; withdraw large lump sums from 7-Eleven ATMs to minimize per-transaction fees rather than using cards for small konbini buys.

December in Japan is cold and dry but occasional rain is possible; pack versatile, thin layers and a windproof outer shell rather than a single heavy coat, as you'll be moving between freezing temples and heated indoors constantly.
For a group of 8, always make dinner reservations—walk-ins for large parties at popular izakayas and ramen shops will result in long splits or outright rejections, especially during the holiday week.
